Kerbside 0.7.19 release trigger.

Purpose: prevent an already verified live bus from flickering off simply because its straight-line distance or bearing temporarily points away from the selected stop. Real routes can loop, bend, detour and use one-way streets while still serving the stop. First admission stays strict; confirmed passed geometry, genuine branch/journey conflicts, route/operator changes, stale GPS and implausible position jumps still fail closed.
